svg.title: The triage player: what it is made of

g.text: The triage player: what it is made of: louis-agent.pack.triage.web, Demo / TriagePlayer
Who puts it on a page
the site's words, the stage and the step, in two columns
a lane per agent, the one at work lit
one step: who took it, what it did and why
A box inside a box is held by it.

text.tspan: the stage shows the team as lanes with the agent at work lit, and a step picked on it is explained beside it.
